comment: THE PATH → RULES MAP — which guideline sections and named rules own a path's conventions. A review's reading set is derived from the paths a change touched, through this file, rather than from the sections the change's own artifacts claim (`documentation-ownership`, "The review's reading set is derived from the change's paths"). Two invariants are checked by `tools/check-rule-routes.sh`: every `glob` matches a tracked path (a rename orphans the rules a reader is told to read) and every named rule under `guidelines/` is reached by at least one glob (a rule no change is ever told to obey). This file is the one a second project adapts; the check reads its path from `tools/tooling.json` `docRoutes` and names no glob as a literal.

Regulatory.md §2 "keep the obey-signs disclaimer and the diagnostics trail, and claim no accuracy the data cannot support."
